design: 24 train / 24 held-out role-credit ablation on correctly specified width-2 swarm. Frozen role bonuses applied as a 15% relative proposal-score adjustment.
training_role_pattern: Immediate, leave-one-out, trajectory-to-go and one-step structural credit all favored INFOGAIN/FALSIFY and penalized RIVAL. Naive terminal credit uniquely favored RIVAL, making its best held-out mean a surprising attribution anomaly rather than an expected result.
interpretation: No credit method is established at n=24. Naive terminal credit has the best mean recovery but remains statistically unresolved and uses a qualitatively suspicious role attribution. Power it on a fresh test set and separate the reward scheme from the resulting RIVAL-favoring heuristic.
next: EXP-002I2 powered naive-terminal replication plus explicit RIVAL-bonus mechanism control
